meta.name: mobile-app-launch-checklist
meta.description: Comprehensive step-by-step launch checklist for shipping mobile apps to the iOS App Store and Google Play Store. Covers pre-submission preparation, store asset creation, build and submission, launch day execution, and post-launch monitoring. Use when the user wants to launch a mobile app, prepare for App Store or Google Play submission, create a launch plan, review submission requirements, or ensure nothing is missed before releasing an app. Triggers on "launch checklist", "app submission", "prepare for launch", "app store submission", "google play submission", "ready to ship", "pre-launch review", "launch day plan".
